title: IBAO Global Leadership in Ethics and Supervision

presenter.name: Dr Michael Mueller
presenter.title: Founder
presenter.bio: Dr. Michael Mueller is a world-renowned Board Certified Behavior Analyst-Doctoral level and the Founder of the International Behavior Analysis Organization (IBAO). He is an international authority on behavioral ethics, quality supervision systems, and credentialing standards worldwide.

certification.notes: Participation is 100% FREE. CEU Certification is paid. Payment details are provided on the registration form.

audience: ABA professionals, paraprofessionals, parents, caregivers, and all players involved in behaviour analysis.

title: Dr. Ed.'s Model for Behavior Analysis and Intervention: The Loci of Ethics in Action.

presenter.name: Dr Edward Usifo Asikhia
presenter.title: Renowned Behavior Analyst & Creator of Dr. Ed.'s Model
presenter.bio: Dr. Edward Usifo Asikhia (BCBA-D) is a distinguished doctoral-level behavior analyst renowned for his clinical interventions and scholarly contributions. In this masterclass, Dr. Asikhia presents Dr. Ed.'s Model for Behavior Analysis and Intervention, exploring the practical and ethical dimensions of behavior analysis in action.

certification.notes: Attendance is FREE but Registration is Compulsory. CEU Certificates Available (2 Units).

audience: ABA Professionals, Parents, Caregivers and All Interested Stakeholders.
highlights: Dr. Ed.'s Model for Behavior Analysis
The Loci of Ethics in Action
